pages.title: Furnaces
pages.text: Furnaces need body, lid, flame and an installed formula. Tiers run 1–5. They are multiblock stations that must be formed and commissioned; see Station Operations.

pages.title: Success and Wear
pages.text: Success scales with life-skill proficiency and station efficiency. Explosions, blown lids and failed brews wear the station (80/30/8). Full-bag outputs enqueue to the delivery outbox.

pages.title: Recipe Browser
pages.text: 129 authority alchemy recipes. With JEI, all five furnace tiers are catalysts and the progress region opens the category. Remote clients use the packaged manifest baseline.

pages.title: Pill Effects
pages.text: Catalog pills honor realm gates, flat spirit, tags and risk. No-benefit cases refuse consumption. Death substitution, tribulation aid and beast feeding are wired.
